name: Dubai Jobs & Hiring
about: Salary-transparent job leads, CV feedback, interview practice, and respectful hiring conversations.

stories.author: p84
stories.text: A good job post includes salary range, location, and visa context.

stories.author: p13
stories.text: Interview questions should reveal the work, not free consulting.

posts.author: p84
posts.text: Hiring thread: what makes you trust a Dubai job listing before sending your CV? I am collecting signals that help newcomers avoid vague offers.

comments.author: p13
comments.text: A named company domain, clear responsibilities, salary range, and a real office or video contact. Never pay a recruiter for an offer.

comments.author: p84
comments.text: Good distinction: a recruiter can ask for time, but the candidate should not be charged for access to a job.

comments.author: p27
comments.text: I also verify the hiring manager on the company site and ask what the first 30 days look like.

comments.author: p56
comments.text: And compare the whole package: base, housing, insurance, commute, and visa responsibility.

comments.author: p84
comments.text: I will add a checklist with those fields and label it community advice, not legal advice.

posts.author: p13
posts.text: CV review request: how do you show measurable work when your previous employer will not let you share client names?

comments.author: p27
comments.text: Use the problem, action, and result without naming the client: reduced processing time by 20%, for example.

comments.author: p13
comments.text: That keeps the evidence while respecting confidentiality. I will rewrite the first bullet that way.

comments.author: p84
comments.text: Also keep a private portfolio of what you are allowed to show; do not upload confidential slides.
